description: API process health: CPU, memory, event loop lag, GC, restarts and the health of the observability stack.

panels.title: Navigation
panels.description: Links to the other Time Manager dashboards. The alert rules live under Alerting > Alert rules.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the API process started.

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Process restarts in the last 24 hours, from process_start_time_seconds changes (no cAdvisor in this stack).

panels.title: Memory (RSS)
panels.description: Resident set size of the API process.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by the API process.

panels.title: Event loop lag p99
panels.description: 99th percentile event loop delay. Above 100 ms users feel it; alert above 500 ms.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Open file descriptors against the process limit.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU seconds per second, user versus system.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory, heap and external memory.

panels.title: Event loop lag
panels.description: Event loop delay: mean, p50, p90, p99 and max.

panels.title: GC time
panels.description: Seconds per second spent in garbage collection, by kind.

panels.title: Active handles and requests
panels.description: Libuv handles and pending requests: a steady climb means a leak.

panels.title: Heap by space
panels.description: V8 heap usage per space.

panels.title: Pool max connections
panels.description: Configured DATABASE_POOL_MAX of the API (db_pool_max_connections).

panels.title: Readiness probe duration
panels.description: Duration of GET /health/ready, dominated by the database round trip.

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: Every scrape target Alloy knows about; Up=0 means the target is down.

panels.title: Samples ingested
panels.description: Prometheus head samples appended per second.

panels.title: Active series
panels.description: Prometheus head series: watch for cardinality explosions.

panels.title: Spans received by Tempo
panels.description: Spans accepted by the Tempo distributor per second.

panels.title: Loki ingestion
panels.description: Bytes received by the Loki distributor per second.

panels.title: Remote-write failures
panels.description: Samples Alloy failed to write to Prometheus per second (should be zero).

title: Time Manager - Node.js Runtime
